verdict.rationale: An official iOS app is documented through its App Store listing, with photo upload, Advanced Voice Mode and image generation. Android appears only in a single mention that ChatGPT Work tasks can continue on iOS or Android. Several highlighted capabilities (Computer Use, Goal mode, voice task coordination) are documented only for the desktop app, so 'full-featured' parity on mobile is unproven. Missing for 10: dedicated Android app documentation, evidence of feature parity with desktop/web (Work, projects, file tasks) on mobile, independent hands-on corroboration of the mobile apps.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can use full-featured official mobile apps for iOS and Android

citations.quote: continue a task that needs a website account in ChatGPT Work on the web, iOS, or Android
Advanced Voice Mode–Tap the soundwave icon to have a real-time convo on the go.
Photo upload—Snap or upload a picture to transcribe a handwritten recipe or get info about a landmark.
Image generation–Generate original images from a description, or transform existing ones with a few simple words.
